description: This file defines the final class 'Query' within the 'GuzzleHttp\Psr7' namespace. It provides static methods for parsing query strings into arrays and building query strings from arrays, handling various encoding formats.

classes.name: Query
classes.description: Provides static methods for parsing and building URL query strings with support for different encodings.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a query string into an associative array, decoding values according to specified encoding options.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds a query string from an array of parameters, encoding values as specified.
